S.No. Terms& Conditions Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA): Vendor must sign NDA within 10 calendar days fro m date of publishing tender. The detailed specification will be shared only upon subm 1 ission of duly signed NDA as per the format attached. Signed NDA documents (soft copy) should be send through email only. e-mail ID: bdl dneimm-ap@bdl-india.in Total value wise evaluation: i. Bidder shall quote for all the items and full quantity of each item. 2 ii. The evaluation will be done considering all the items as a set and L1 will be arrived based on overall lowest for the set. iii. Quotation for partial items/ partial quantities will not be considered. iv. Contract will be placed based on overall L1.

3 Vendor should have prior experience in development of similar kind of off-road UGV. Vendor should have successfully supplied atleast one UGV having pay-load carrying c 4 apacity of atleast 100 Kg to DRDO laboratory/ Defence PSUs/ Indian armed force/ IITs/ NITs or other government research organization. Vendor shall submit documentary evidence in support such as purchase order/ compl 5 etion certificate/ acceptance certificate or other relevant supporting document issued by the concerned organization. A pre-bid meeting shall be conducted tentatively within 15 days from date of tender r 6 elease. Vendor shall not be eligible to participate for pre-bid meeting without submitting sign 7 ed NDA. Vendor shall not be eligible for submission of the bid without participating in pre-bid 8 meeting. Pre-bid meeting shall be conducted for two days, the schedule & details will be comm unicated to vendor upon submission of duly signed NDA. 9 Vendor failing to attend pre-bid meeting shall not be consider to participate in the ten der. Item is required to be delivered at BDL-KBU as per the specification mentioned at App 10 endix - 'B", which will be shared upon submission of NDA. Acceptance of the item will be based on successful completion of Factory acceptance 11 test (before dispatch) and site acceptance test at BDL premise. Acceptance Criteria: Final acceptance is at BDL, Kanchanbagh after verification of deli 12 verables, as per the Specifications Documents. Delivery Schedule: Items should be delivered within 90 days from the date of PO/ Ge 13 M Contract. In case of damage of material during transportation for delivery or rejection of compo 14 nent during validation/ testing, BDL will not bear any cost. Warranty Period: Supplier should provide warranty for a period of 1 year from the dat 15 e of acceptance at BDL, Kanchanbagh at free of cost. BDL will not provide any test facility. 16 All Equipment/ facility required to carryout test/ inspection of the materials are in ven dor's scope only. Payment Terms: i) 90% order value plus 100% taxes and duties (as applicable) shall be paid within 30 days against receipt of material and acceptance at BDL. 17 Balance 10% shall be paid against submission of Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) for 5% of PO basic value valid upto Warranty Period plus 03 months claim period, by way of online payment/ Demand draft / Bankers Cheque / Bank Guarantee from sched uled bank. ii) Payment will be on pro-rata basis for accepted items. Price Quoted: Free Delivery at BDL Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad; i.e. inspection, packing 18 & forwarding, freight, transit insurance etc. are in supplier scope only.

Taxes: GST will be extra as applicable at the time of supply. In case of delay beyond d 19 elivery schedules of Purchase Order, then any increase in levies at the time of supply will not be considered and only the earlier percentage of levy will be paid. 20 Bidder to indicate their GSTIN. 21 Mention % GST. 22 Mention 8-digit HSN code. 23 Bidder to provide BDL Vendor Code (if available). Liquidated Damages: As per GeM terms i.e. If the seller / Service Provider fails to delivery any or all the Goods / Services within the original / re-fixed delivery Period(s) specified in the contract, the Buyer will be entitled to deduct / recover the Liquidated 24 Damages for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure conditions aforesaid, @0. 5% of the contract value of delayed quantity per week or part of the week of delayed period as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contract value of delayed quantity without any controversy/ dispute of any sore whatsoever. 25 No FIMs will be issued by BDL. 26 No custom duty exemption certificate will be issued by BDL. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has / have quoted price within L-1+ 15% (Selec 27 ted by Buyer) of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy , such MSE Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be a warded for 100% (selected by Buyer) percentage of total quantity. Packing & Forwarding: It is the responsibility of the supplier to ensure that packaging i s adequate to protect the items during transportation. 28 Items should be securely packed as per standard specification / guidelines for severe road transport conditions and the packing charges to be borne by the supplier only. Bidders should not provide any price details in technical bid; otherwise their bid may 29 be disqualified/ rejected. BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflecte 30 d in GSTR-2B /2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law. The vendor should also report/ intimate BDL, if any case/ FIR is filed/ registered again 31 st them during any stage of execution of the PO/ SO in the attached format of underta king. The bidder / Vendor has to submit certificate of under taking at the bid submission sta ge about cases/ FIRs pending / registered in any of the court of law/ police station in t 32 he country or abroad with regard to items floated in the tender enquiry as per the att ached format along with the technical bid/ techno commercial bid. Should there be any court case pending, involving the items which are the part of ten der enquiry the bidder at the time of submission of bid(s) itself should enclose an ord 33 er received from the court in which the matter is sub-judice that “bidder is allowed to participate in the tender enquiry and if succeeded in the bidding that there will not be any harm or disadvantages to the interest of the organization i.e. BDL in entering and completing the contract after awarding to it”. BDL reserves the right to debar the bidder/ vendor, in case of false claims and non-dis 34 closure/avoiding of information about pending court cases / FIRs registered against th e firm/ vendor.

The Vendors participating in the Tender should declare if demerged in the recent time s, to declare the demerger, nature of demerger for assessment of the credentials for a 35 cceptance of your quotations, failing which on knowing of the demerger in the later st age by BDL, BDL will entitle the Vendor for debarment. RISK PURCHASE CLAUSE: In the event the supplier fails to fulfil the Purchase Order obligations, BDL reserves th e right: To purchase elsewhere without notice to the vendor, on account and at the ris k of the vendor, the stores not delivered or other of similar description (Which in the o pinion of BDL shall be readily procurable) without cancelling the Purchase Order in re 36 spect of consignment not yet due for delivery. (OR) To cancel the Purchase Order in the event action being taken as above the vendor sh all be liable for any loss which BDL may sustain on that account by the vendor shall n ot be entitled to any gain on repurchase made against default.
